accepted_decision: Ten real public source theorem nodes with necessary private proof closures. No extra wrapper nodes are required.

source_coverage.comparison: Every public declaration and private copy retains its complete prior statement and proof. Private copies add only the private modifier.

scope_checks.detail: Independent reconstruction checks each complete selected source fragment, including namespace, section, variable, include, omit, attributes and notation commands.
Each source helper reference resolves statically to a same-module declaration or a public imported node. No reference requires another module private alias.
Repeated userName values denote separate module owners. Every private copy reaches its own public theorem through actual proof calls.
mem_of_isIntegral and the PID bridge are copied only into their actual consumers. Their complete proofs and contexts remain intact.
The original target owns the complete source generic uniqueness, scalar derivative and inverse chain proofs privately. No derivation-law hypothesis replaces them.
The source-checked four existing derivAlong constructions remain the inputs. Local ascent, uniform bounds, Order formulas and final actual-place obstruction retain their previous full proofs.
The sole new Definitions module contains the original uniformizer definition and no theorem. The entire project closure has no Definitions-to-Theorems import.
The reorganization preserves source content and contexts. It introduces no mathematical assumption, placeholder, axiom or additional Open node.

notes.detail: Bind audit facts by (module, userName). Compiler-generated private indices remain unknown until elaboration.
Full declared types and their source contexts match. This report does not claim elaborated type equality, tactic acceptance, kernel acceptance or allowed axiom output.
Every selected public filename matches its actual full theorem name and uses ASCII. This audit does not validate a transformed platform payload or call the platform.
